tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen ground. Light: the brand yellow every screen sits on. Dark: deep grape. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card face (HeroStat, StreakCard, RankCard, list groups, sheets). Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside a card: text fields, stepper wells, empty badge slots. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, icon strokes and illustration outlines on bg, surface and surface-alt. Also the fill of the inverse Ticker card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, timestamps, axis labels) on bg, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 3px outline on cards, pills, chips and the tab bar. Light: same as ink. Dark: near-black so cards read as cut-outs; decorative there, separation comes from the surface lift.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Color of the hard offset shadow (shadow-pop). Never blurred.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: The FunFitness yellow. Light: it is the bg. Dark: greeting headline, selected tab pill, focus ring. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action and Distance identity: LogButton, primary Button, progress fill, the DISTANCE tag. Text on it: on-accent only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent, brand-yellow, type-distance, type-duration and type-reps fills, in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Secondary brand hue and Weight identity: the WEIGHT LIFTED tile, rank medal ribbon, links on surface (light only). Text on it: on-accent-2.

tokens.name: on-accent-2
tokens.usage: Text on accent-2 and type-weight fills. Flips to dark text in dark mode because the lifted purple is too light for white.

tokens.name: type-distance
tokens.usage: Distance fills: tag, meter fill, chart bars, heatmap top step. Text on it: on-type-distance.

tokens.name: on-type-distance
tokens.usage: Text on type-distance.

tokens.name: type-weight
tokens.usage: Weight fills: stat tile, meter fill, chart bars. Text on it: on-type-weight.

tokens.name: on-type-weight
tokens.usage: Text on type-weight.

tokens.name: type-duration
tokens.usage: Duration fills: stat tile, meter fill, chart bars. Text on it: on-type-duration.

tokens.name: on-type-duration
tokens.usage: Text on type-duration.

tokens.name: type-reps
tokens.usage: Reps fills: stat tile, meter fill, chart bars. Also the pack illustrations' warm fill. Text on it: on-type-reps.

tokens.name: on-type-reps
tokens.usage: Text on type-reps.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of every ProgressMeter, empty chart bars, heatmap step 0.

tokens.name: streak
tokens.usage: Streak flame and the StreakCard number chip. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved / synced / shield-used confirmations as text on surface. Always paired with a word or check glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete Session, Delete All Data) as text on surface, and error messages. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / Full Keyboard Access focus ring, 3px, offset 3px from the element so it lands on bg.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Activity heatmap step 1 (one entry that day).

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Activity heatmap step 2.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Activity heatmap step 3 (busiest days). Same as type-distance.

tokens.name: island
tokens.usage: Dynamic Island background. Always black; iOS draws it.

tokens.name: island-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the Dynamic Island.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The one giant count on HeroStat and Celebration. One per screen.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Totals on StatTile, StreakCard and widgets. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The comparison phrase under display-hero; sheet titles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card titles, button labels, tab labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text and comparison sentences. Nunito at 600 so it holds up next to Fredoka.
styles.sample: That's the weight of a mama hippo!

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; list row titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meter end labels, timestamps, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tags and section eyebrows (DISTANCE, WEIGHT LIFTED). Always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked text lines in a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; meter to its end labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a stack.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap before a new section (pack picker, Recent Activity).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of Celebration content; space above the greeting.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips inside cards, icon chips, heatmap cells (4px is too sharp for this direction).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: StatTile, text fields, segmented control, widgets' inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: HeroStat and every full card; sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, pack chips, buttons, meters, tab bar, LogButton.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow on cards, selected chips, LogButton and primary buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state: the element moves 4px down-right and the shadow shrinks to this.

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: Outline on cards, tab bar, LogButton, illustrations.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Outline on chips, segmented control, toggles, meters.
